column1: # The build scripts gate 13's verdicts rest on (scripts/verified_contracts.py,
# THE BUILD-SCRIPT PREMISE).
# `targo trust check` runs every build script of the lane's unit graph outside
# the proof channel: uncontained, as the same uid (Trust blocker B5; the
# premise is P-CORESIDENT). The report states each execution as a
# `build-execution-scope` row, "proof is conditional on this exact execution
# unit's correctness". Every law gate 13 proves, and every mutant it refutes,
# therefore rests on the scripts below.
# The gate holds the build-script executions of every JUDGED run (base and
# mutants) EQUAL to these rows and prints them; the rule is stated once, as
# THE BUILD-SCRIPT PREMISE in scripts/verified_contracts.py.
# Columns (TAB-separated; one header line):
#   package  the Cargo package name.
#   source   the package id's source as the report spells it; `path` for a
#            path package (never its local path).
#   version  the exact version; `workspace` for a path package at the root's
#            [workspace.package] version, so a version bump does not move it.
#   does     what the script does, read from its build.rs (a review note).
# A new row is a new uncontained executable under the gate's verdicts: read
# the script before adding it. scripts/tests/test_verified_contracts.py holds
# every registry row to Cargo.lock and every path row to a member's build.rs.
